title: shuteye
overview: A student researching sleep paralysis slips into a lucid nightmare.

title: The Fields of Abbottsville
overview: In Ohio, late 2004, after a young religious fanatic Joshua Tinsman (Brennan Abbott) celebrates his 18th birthday. He is then forced into committing crimes by his preacher Ron Tinsman Jr. (Aaron Hickman) that he doesn't want to follow through on. Years of indoctrination and influence from his friends discourages him from leaving. After all, it's the ideology that he and his childhood friend Stephen grew up with since birth. How can you leave something you spent your whole life working towards? Loosely based on a true story.

title: JIĀ: A Taiwan Story
overview: Upcoming Hugh J. Service Taiwan Documentary.

title: Twisted
overview: As the heir to her parents’ legendary pizzeria, Angelina, a feisty Italian teenager, fears breaking tradition might break their hearts. As her desire to break free grows, so do her lies. But when her web of deceit spins out of control, she opens a portal to a wondrous and treacherous mythical underworld putting her family in grave danger. To right her wrong, she is forced to team up with a neurotic but sensitive, truth-telling monster. The unlikely duo sets off on a mind-blowing journey to save the very traditions Angelina wanted to leave behind. A modern coming-of-age adventure, Twisted explores the universal themes of soul-searching. It challenges our relationship with truth, lies and looks at how life-changing decisions can sometimes affect the people we love.

title: Dive 2: The Journey Continues
overview: Vignesh, a skilled swimmer, thinks winning in the pool is all he needs for success. But when his teammate Aanya quits swimming to focus on studies, he starts rethinking his choices. Struggling with school and swimming, Vignesh feels lost until his mom encourages him to find balance. With hard work, he improves in both and learns that real success comes from giving your best in all areas of life.

title: The Nightingale
overview: The lives of two French sisters are torn apart by the onset of World War II.

title: Puro R.A.P.

title: Panic Carefully
overview: Described as a paranoid thriller about a hunt for a cyber-terrorist in the vein of Mr. Robot and The Silence of the Lambs.

title: The Liberation

Her daughters Ella and Jo put everything on the line to infiltrate the cult and bring their mother home. Yet, once immersed in the commune, they find themselves inexorably drawn into the Leader’s labyrinthine web of psycho-spiritual manipulation.

title: MIKE.
overview: Based on real events, a young man is consumed by buried trauma and destructive impulses. As family matters pull him into a chaotic downward spiral, he is forced to confront his past before he loses himself forever.

original_title: The Curse of the Silver Chain
overview: A silver chain that appears for centuries made by warlocks in the 15th century.

As more dead relatives begin appearing throughout the neighborhood, Gino must find a way to eliminate the holiday revenants and make it through the family gathering alive.

title: Steps
overview: Think you know Cinderella's “evil” stepsisters? Think again! When misunderstood Lilith is blamed for hijacking the Royal Ball with a stolen magic wand, she accidentally turns her sister Margot into a frog and leaves the kingdom in the hands of a prince-obsessed mean girl. Now Lilith must team up with Cinderella — and a surprisingly dreamy troll — to save the kingdom, repair the fractured fairytale, and prove that even so-called villains deserve a shot at happily-ever-after.

title: Cameron Winter at Carnegie Hall
overview: A concert film documenting Cameron Winter's sold-out performance at Carnegie Hall.

title: Being Heumann
overview: Scrappy, defiant, and done being treated like a burden, Judy Heumann turns her outrage into a revolution. In 1977, she and more than 100 disability rights protestors send a very loud message: The system is broken—not us.

title: Bullet and Lace
overview: Bullet and Lace, a neon-soaked, Giallo-inspired nightmare, follows a young woman whose favorite true crime podcast becomes the voice of the masked intruder stalking her through the night.

title: A Talent for Murder
overview: A young man travels from New York to Switzerland to try to persuade acclaimed thriller writer Patricia Highsmith to write one final installment of her Tom Ripley series, with his efforts gradually turning more sinister.

title: Dolioo
overview: Sarah Jamson, daughter of Hudson’s murdered ally, wages a one-woman war against Hudson, using stealth, strategy, and vengeance-marked corpses to haunt him psychologically. Chloe Varenne, a symbol of lost love and innocence, becomes the spark that pushes KAEL toward rebellion.

title: The Man Who Tickles
overview: When a serial tickler terrorises the city, a hard-boiled police detective and his bumbling rookie assistant must discover the truth and put an end to the crimes.

title: Art of Destruction
overview: We follow the story of The Thinker bombing at the Cleveland Museum of Art, trying to solve the mystery behind it because no one was ever caught. By following this case, we unravel the whole landscape of Cleveland and the USA in the 60s/70s - student protests, social justice movements, anti-war movements, and radical militant groups. We give a context to the bombing, which is symbolic on so many levels - it's an art piece that randomly became a target for political violence that, by being left unrepaired, became a reminder of the complicated history of the 60s/70s. The Thinker is a silent witness to this fascinating decade, looking down from his pedestal, still thinking about our place in the world as humans.

title: The Love Hypothesis
overview: Olive Smith, a biology PhD candidate, and Dr. Adam Carlsen, a hotshot professor and well-known tyrant, enter into a fake relationship, seeing each of their carefully calculated theories on love get thrown into chaos.

title: The Depths
overview: After a brother and sister achieve astral projection, the footage they capture reveals the malicious effects of their family trauma.

title: Wellness Retreat
overview: A successful business woman seeks out a wellness retreat to improve her sleep. When she finds the location is actually a seedy motel, her exhaustion takes the lead and she chooses to stay the night, despite her better judgment.

title: In Her You'll Find Sanctuary
overview: After the arrival of a nun with mystical visions, Sister Miriam becomes envious of her rival's sudden notoriety and begins falsifying miracles in a grotesque game of spiritual cat-and-mouse.

title: Run Hide Fight: Infidels
overview: After Islamist terrorists hijack a college's pro-Palestine encampment with the goal of enforcing Sharia law on students and executing dissidents whom they deem "infidels", a group of students, a security guard, and a Delta Force veteran team up to fight back.

title: The Taller They Come
overview: A wannabe Australian film director travels to Ghana to produce his dream film, a kung-fu remake of The Harder They Come with Ghanian action sensation, Samuel “Ninja” Nkansah.

title: Ancestors
overview: 1988.  Dreams, memories and history collide as a young man searches for his missing friend.

title: The Scam Artisan
overview: Day by day, sharp and manipulative Jordon Teaspoon sells modern or as some say: "scam" art to his wealthy, high paying clients. Teaspoon's business is booming as usual, until an old client resurfaces threatening the existence of the phony life Jordon has built.

title: Moonfish
overview: A grieving astronaut who's lost his only companion on a deep-space mining mission must fulfill a strict corporate quota to return home. As his year of solitude passes, his grip on reality unravels the line between the living and non-living.

title: Zero Intention of Living Quietly
overview: Mistreated by people unable to cope with his unique visible difference, actor Adam Pearson glimpses a path away from isolation through his love of cinema. Upon meeting kindred spirit Ellie - a girl who shares his genetic condition, NF1 - their quest begins to forge a new type of movie hero, and finally press play on life.

title: The Idiot(s)
overview: Fyodor Dostoyevsky and his wife Anna travel to Europe for their honeymoon and end up staying in a health resort in Switzerland, only to return to Russia after four years. Fyedya can’t shake his roulette habit and keeps losing their money. His wife accepts this fate since he keeps assuring her that it’s all for inspiration and soon he shall write his to-be masterpiece, 'The Idiot'.

title: Hauntshow
overview: The twisted final broadcast of an underground variety show. A mysterious, macabre, deviant and delinquent double-bill of chillers hosted by Hauntrella, Hauntressa and the dearly departed Hauntiana.

title: Zip Wire
overview: When her ground-breaking pharmaceutical discovery is stolen and partner murdered, researcher Amy must face her fear of heights to escape nefarious attackers, with the only path to salvation being a treacherous aerial runway. To outsmart the mysterious hostiles, she has to summon every ounce of courage to protect the world-changing scientific discovery — and herself — before it's too late.

title: Claire McKenna
overview: After years of addiction and isolation, Claire McKenna is finally home from rehab. It’s her first day back—and her first day of probation.  Anxiously awaiting her parole officer, Claire discovers something from her old life that suddenly puts her fragile new beginning into question.  To everyone around her, the moment may seem insignificant. For Claire, it’s a fierce and deeply personal battle to remain sober, honest, and alive.

title: Erased
overview: When confronted by the now 18-year-old son he dismissed before birth, a high-powered businessman must decide between their potential relationship and a life changing financial opportunity.

title: Echoes of The Forks of Cypress
original_title: Echoes of The Forks of Cypress
overview: Echoes of Forks of Cypress explores the lives of the enslaved and enslavers at the Forks of Cypress plantation in Florence, AL. The documentary highlights their struggles, resilience, and the plantation’s historical significance. It then shifts to the present, where descendants from both sides come together to confront and heal from their shared past.

title: My Playground
overview: Trapped in Dubai where riding is “not allowed,” a young BMX rider hits the road on a worldwide adventure to find  epic spots, a real community — and himself.

title: The Ghost and The Gun
overview: In 1948 Malaya, WWII vets Iz and Abe face vengeful ex-ally Chin Liu, who betrayed them during the war and now leads terrorists to their village. Haunted by past trauma, Iz must confront both his demons and Chin Liu's deadly advance.

title: Doorman
overview: On a first date, a young woman gets herself entangled with a man who is desperate to stay in her life no matter how far he has to go.

title: Wildcards

The prosecution is led by Assistant State Attorney James Jones, an overworked yet determined prosecutor, who faces off against Greg Sims, a veteran defense attorney with an unbroken 25-year winning streak.

title: Tina Arena: Unravel Me
overview: How do you separate a Melbourne-born Oz music treasure and cosmopolitan star from a resilient woman? Follow the threads of her story, in her own words.

title: Pickleballers

Luckily, her two best friends Charlotte and Spence have an idea. The internet show sensation 'Balloon Shop' is having a pickleball tournament with a huge cash prize. The only problem - none of them know what pickleball is.  With an array of unhinged new friends support, Max and her new partner Lexi are ready to take it all on. The only wall in their way is Rachel Summers. The token town mean girl with a vendetta aimed right at Max's forehead.  Rachel hires a 5 time tournament winning pickleball player as her partner to ensure Max and Lexi stand no chance at all.  So, with the odds stacked against them the gang have no choice but to give it everything they've got.

title: Gals

At this point, Scarlette is gifted a book of black magic and a switch goes off. With the powers that the book holds, Scarlette discovers that revenge is far more satisfying than forgiveness.

title: The House

With his grandson Nikola, who has Asperger's syndrome and is living without social contacts, he travels to his homeland, a village in Serbia, to sell the family land, but becomes a part of a local population rebellion against the construction mafia that threatens to destroy everything that is left of his homeland.

title: 睡觉第一名
overview: "Sleeping Champion" (睡觉第一名) is a 12-minute brand short film released in August 2026. It was directed by Shao Yihui (邵艺辉) in collaboration with the sleep-wellness brand Atour Planet (亚朵星球).

Hosted by Susan Egan and Ginnifer Goodwin, the concert is a centerpiece performance for this year's World Princess Week programming and promises an evening of pure nostalgia and celebration, a perfect family watch for fans of all ages. You won't want to miss a single note.

According to the least-selling book of 1655 —The Nice and Accurate Prophecies of Agnes Nutter, Witch — the world will come to an end on a Saturday  Next Saturday in fact.  The Armies of Good and Evil are massing, the Four Horsemen have been unleashed. Atlantis is rising, frogs are falling, tempers are flaring, and everything appears to be going to Divine Plan.  Except that a fastidious Angel and a fast-living Demon, who have enjoyed a rather decadent lifestyle on earth for six millennia, are not particularly looking forward to the coming Rapture. They just have to find a way to indefinitely postpone Armageddon.  There’s only one problem: they’ve misplaced the Anti-Christ.

The Wolf in Winter embeds with the greatest tennis player of all time as he returned to the Australian Open in 2025, capturing the obsession, the preparation, and the fire that won't go out even when there's nothing left to prove.

Following the care of Katy, a cat brought to the clinic by a rescue agency, the film looks at the compassion, connection and emotional strain that comes with caring for animals, while highlighting the often-overlooked impact of compassion fatigue on veterinary professionals.

title: Honor Among Thieves
overview: In early 1970, an amateur film crew shot a no-budget heist movie in Knoxville, TN. Throughout the shoot, cast members gathered in an abandoned quarry, a local bar, and a defunct bank building to get their vision on film. The cinematographer perched on top of a car to film a highway chase, and the whole company trekked into the foothills for a climactic foot pursuit and brawl. The resulting film, HONOR AMONG THIEVES, was never seen widely and never made a dime--but it did get its writer-director out of a term paper.

title: The Imp
overview: A short film by the makers of Honor Among Thieves.

title: Shiawase wa Tabete Nete Mate: Soshun no Yojo Hen
original_title: しあわせは食べて寝て待て～早春の養生編～
overview: Mugimaki Satoko, who has developed an illness she will have to live with for the rest of her life, commutes from an apartment complex where the rent is 50,000 yen to her part-time job four days a week. Having given up on moving to the countryside, she has been feeling somewhat depressed.  One winter day, Tsukasa, who is staying next door, invites her to go for an early-morning walk, but she turns him down. Satoko, who feels self-conscious because everything requires physical strength, is hesitant and says, "Someone like me..." even as her landlady, Suzu, and neighbor Koma get excited talking about romance. Suzu then invites Satoko to her home.  Amid her usual daily life with her coworkers and friends from the apartment complex, surrounded by medicinal cuisine, Satoko gradually finds small moments of happiness. This is a special episode about those ordinary yet quietly wonderful days.

title: The Boy Who Collects Spider-Man
overview: What if Spider-Man’s most important mission wasn’t saving the city? In The Boy Who Collects Spider-Man, Spider-Man meets his biggest fan, Tim—a kid who’s collected everything about him, from his first appearance to every battle he’s ever fought. What starts as a dream come true quickly becomes something deeper as Tim begins asking real questions about power, responsibility, and what it means to be a hero, forcing Peter to open up in ways he never has before. But as the night goes on, Spider-Man realizes this isn’t just a visit—it’s a moment that matters more than anything he’s done in the suit, proving that being a hero isn’t about fighting villains or saving the world, but about showing up for someone when they need it most.

title: Michelle's Mobile Medium
overview: When a hopelessly romantic spiritual medium meets her next hot catch (and client), she soon learns that this time, the story really isn't her new future with her client as much as it is his past.

The Carpet Muckers twirling gorches but the Garbites are way too hungry for karaoke flavored peanut butter screams.

title: Meeting Marsha
overview: An aspiring actress must put her marriage proposal on pause to her comedian girlfriend, when her biological mother and infamous TV star, Marsha Davis, wants to finally meet. What should be a lovely and unforgettable weekend, turns more nightmarish than anyone could have ever expected.

overview: Will heads to a party to meet his brother, but something isn't right. Chaos ensues and Will's world collapses around him. An aggressive, symbolic tale of grief and loss.

title: MOOSAP (Memories of Old Sapang Palay)
overview: Blending 1970s archives with modern parallels, MOOSAP explores the fractured memories of Sapang Palay. Displaced from Manila under the false promise of a better life, settlers faced severe neglect, eventually marching to Malacañang to demand basic necessities. This experimental film juxtaposes historical struggles with contemporary cycles of displacement, questioning how long a community must walk before their voices are truly heard and the cycle of empty promises finally ends.

title: Sawtooth Mountain
overview: Three college students get entangled in a horrifying ordeal after booking a Bigfoot-themed cabin run by two paranormal-obsessed brothers.

title: Rebel Flowers
overview: A nun is forced to confront her own past and make a decision destined to change the course of her life forever. When her best friend asks her help, faith, guilt, and friendship collide.

title: Epitaph
overview: Newlywed Anna and her husband relocate to Alaska, but their blissful life takes a dark turn when a car crash causes Anna to develop selective amnesia. The incident triggers agoraphobia and haunting flashbacks.

title: House of Death
overview: At night, a boy is terrorized by a dark latex figure.

overview: In this tender, intimate and humorous documentary, experience the adventures and frustrations of a pair of inseparable lovers as they dream of building a life together

title: Otter

title: Tight Lettuce
overview: A son films his father's addiction, hoping to document his recovery; but as he sacrifices everything to save him, he must decide how much he'll lose for someone who may not want saving.

title: Manhunt

Their flight, live-tracked across social media and news feeds, unfolded like a fever dream of the digital age: an openworld simulation of fear and fascination. Weeks later, their bodies were found by a river, the chase ending as abruptly as it began.

title: The Minusio Tapes
overview: Decades after burying a series of recordings he believed lost forever, a respected architect dies. When the tapes are discovered beneath his home, a stranger appears at his daughter's door claiming to know the man better than she ever did.  The Minusio Tapes is a study in what survives concealment: how the past insists on being found, one recording at a time.  Produced under the creative supervision of Ramon Zürcher and Silvan Zürcher during the Locarno Film Festival 2026 Spring Academy.

title: Big Chicken: A Fast Food Conspiracy
original_title: Big Chicken: A Fast Food Conspiracy
overview: In a bold 28-day experiment, comedian Mo Gilligan tours the UK and US on a fried chicken diet to uncover the impact of the craving — and industry behind it.

They are hunted by the Abnormal Defense Force, paramilitary police that specialize in ruthlessly exterminating ‘freaks‘ like them. Mary is fueled by revenge, determined to find the ADF officer who killed her first child.

title: The Messenger

title: Passing By
overview: Three strangers navigating a world suspended between memory and reality, where unfinished dreams refuse to disappear and every choice echoes beyond time. Bound by invisible burdens, they confront loss, identity, and the fragile hope of becoming more than the lives they almost lived. Through a poetic reinterpretation of limbo, the film explores the silent rebellion of simply continuing to exist.

title: Prompt: Make a Documentary
overview: Prompt: Make a Documentary investigates the growing influence of artificial intelligence on the film industry.  The documentary places the rise of AI within the broader historical context of cinema’s evolution, drawing parallels with earlier technological shifts such as the introduction of sound, colour, and digital visual effects. By revisiting landmark moments in film history, the film demonstrates that disruption has always been part of cinema’s DNA, while questioning whether AI represents a fundamentally different kind of change.  Featuring insights from directors, academics, and practitioners, Prompt: Make a Documentary explores the tension between innovation and integrity, the democratisation of creative tools, and the ethical implications of automation in the arts. The film ultimately asks whether artificial intelligence will empower the next generation of storytellers or redefine creativity itself.
